Biro terms of use (beta)

Draft. Effective [[EFFECTIVE_DATE]].

These terms are an agreement between you and [[OPERATOR]] ("we"). By using Biro you agree to them. Please also read the privacy policy.

1. It's a beta

Biro is an early test version shared with friends and family. Expect bugs, and things may change or stop working. Please tell us when something goes wrong: [[CONTACT_EMAIL]]. We'll do our best to keep your lists safe, but please don't rely on Biro as the only record of anything important.

2. Who can use it

  • An account holder must be 18 or over.
  • Children may use Kid Mode on the account holder's device, with the account holder's permission and supervision. The account holder is responsible for that use.
  • Givers (people with a share link) don't need an account. By claiming or pledging, they agree to these terms too.

3. Biro doesn't sell anything

  • Biro shows products and links to the shops that sell them. We are not the seller. Prices, stock, delivery, returns and product safety are between you and the shop.
  • Prices and pictures come from shops and may be out of date. Always check on the shop's page before buying.
  • Claims are an honour system. Claiming an item holds it for you for 48 hours. "I've bought it" is your word, and we can't check it.
  • Group gifts: Biro never collects, holds or moves money. The organiser collects contributions directly, and any arrangement about money is between the people taking part.

4. Adding products

When you add a product from a link, it stays on your own list. Please don't add anything illegal, unsafe, adult or hateful. We may remove items, and block links or accounts, to keep Biro suitable for families.

5. Your list and share links

  • Your list is yours. You give us permission to store it and show it to the people you share it with, so that Biro can work.
  • Anyone with your share link can see your list. Keep it to people you trust. You can replace the link at any time.

6. Fair use

Please don't break, overload, copy or scrape Biro, and don't use it to harass anyone.

7. Our responsibility

  • We provide Biro "as is" during the beta.
  • We aren't responsible for what shops do, or for gifts that are bought twice, late or not at all.
  • Nothing in these terms limits liability that can't legally be limited. That includes liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, and your statutory rights as a consumer.

8. Ending things

You can stop using Biro and delete your account at any time from Settings. We may end the beta, or suspend an account that breaks these terms. If we end the beta, we'll give you notice and a way to export your lists.

9. Law

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. If you live elsewhere in the UK or EU, you keep the protections of your local consumer law, and you can bring a claim in your local courts.
